description: This file defines the Language class in Drupal, representing interface language information, including properties like id, name, direction, weight, and locked status, along with methods for accessing these properties, sorting languages, and retrieving the default language.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents an interface language with properties such as id, name, direction, weight, and locked status, and includes methods for property access, sorting, and default language retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Language object with provided property values, setting defaults based on predefined language list if necessary.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of the language.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the text direction of the language (LTR or RTL).

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight used for ordering languages.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if this language is the default language.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the language is system-locked and not an actual user language.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts an array of Language objects based on weight and name or id.

methods.name: getDefaultLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the current default language code.
